request.text: [deep guttural growl] Grrrrrhhhh... [wet snarl] Hhhrrraaagh! [raspy panting] hhh... hhh... hhh... [throat rattle] khhhrrrr... [teeth clacking] [low snarl] Rrrrrhhhh... hhhaaagh!
